class Bad:
    n: int

def check(x: int) -> int fail Bad:
    """Return x when it is even, otherwise fail with Bad carrying x."""
    ex check(4) == 4
    ex check(3) == fail Bad(n=3)
    if x % 2 == 1:
        fail Bad(n=x)
    return x

def probe(x: int) -> int | None:
    """Return check(x) when it succeeds, or None when it fails."""
    v = check(x) else return
    return v

def all_even(xs: list[int]) -> list[int] fail Bad:
    """Check every element of xs in parallel. Return the checked list, or fail with the failure of the lowest-index bad element, regardless of which thread finishes first."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex all_even([2, 4, 6]) == [2, 4, 6]
    ex all_even([4, 3, 1]) == fail Bad(n=3)
    oks = par [probe(x) for x in xs]
    out: list[int] = []
    for i in range(xs.len()):
        slot = oks.get(i) else fail Bad(n=xs[i])
        v = slot else fail Bad(n=xs[i])
        out.append(v)
    return out
